selection_scope: 914 training fields only, no validation scores

criterion.data: Only the 914 training fields; prior fixed three stratified folds (seed 2026), not spatial
criterion.quality_gate: A faster method must reproduce ALL pooled OOF predicted labels of the unchanged baseline for every seed, and mean final training loss within 1e-7 bits; otherwise retain baseline
criterion.cost: Lowest median across seeds of the sum of model construction + fold preprocessing + fit + standard inference over all three folds
criterion.ties: Exact timing ties prefer the simpler batched-shift method
criterion.ordering: Rotate method execution order across fold/seed pairs to reduce fixed-order bias
criterion.no_setting_tuning: No additional optimizer/tolerance/budget grid; the change is derivative/evaluation method only
